why-play-is-real-work.title: Why Play Is the Real Work of Childhood
why-play-is-real-work.excerpt: Play looks like fun, but it is serious learning. Through play, children build language, thinking, movement and confidence — one game at a time.

preparing-child-first-day.title: Preparing Your Child for Their First Day at Preschool
preparing-child-first-day.excerpt: A little preparation goes a long way. These simple, gentle steps help your child feel safe and excited about their first day — not scared.

separation-anxiety-gentle-guide.title: Understanding Separation Anxiety: A Gentle Guide for Parents
separation-anxiety-gentle-guide.excerpt: Tears at the classroom door are not a sign that something is wrong. Separation anxiety is a healthy sign of attachment — and it passes.

screen-time-young-children.title: Screen Time and Young Children: Finding a Healthy Balance
screen-time-young-children.excerpt: Screens are everywhere, and a little television or a video call with grandparents is not a failure. What matters is what children watch, and what surrounds the screen.

storytelling-language-imagination.title: How Storytelling Builds Language and Imagination
storytelling-language-imagination.excerpt: Stories are one of the oldest and best tools for building language. A child who is told stories grows richer vocabulary, stronger listening and wilder imagination.

building-independence-at-home.title: Building Independence at Home: Little Jobs, Big Confidence
building-independence-at-home.excerpt: Independence is not born overnight. It is built one tiny “I did it myself” at a time — and the home is the best classroom for it.

outdoor-play-matters.title: Why Outdoor Play Matters for Growing Bodies and Minds
outdoor-play-matters.excerpt: Fresh air, open space and sunshine are not a luxury in early childhood — they are part of the curriculum. Outdoor play builds bodies, balance and brave minds.

naming-emotions.title: Helping Children Name and Express Their Emotions
naming-emotions.excerpt: A child who can say “I am angry” is calmer than a child who only screams. Naming feelings is a skill we can gently teach from the toddler years.

festivals-at-home.title: Celebrating Festivals at Home: Making Traditions Learning Moments
festivals-at-home.excerpt: Festivals are a free and joyful classroom. Food, colours, stories and songs around celebrations teach children about their culture — and about language, numbers and feelings.

becoming-preschool-teacher.title: Becoming a Preschool Teacher: What It Takes
becoming-preschool-teacher.excerpt: A preschool teacher does more than teach letters. They shape how a child feels about learning itself. Here is what the role really asks — and why it is so rewarding.

about.title: A small school with big intentions
about.sub: First Step Preschool is run by Shri Swami Samarth Krupa Foundation — a trust that has been serving the Satpur community for over 25 years.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: First Step Preschool began with a simple observation. Around the Foundation's centre in Satpur, young children were learning — but many parents had no trustworthy place close to home to send their little ones.
story.p2: Parents kept asking for a real preschool — safe, close to home and without franchise fees. Today 101+ children learn here every morning: in large separate classrooms across 2500 sq ft, on a private 3000 sq ft playground, and with parents who know exactly what their child did each day.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.desc: A happy, safe and loving beginning for every child, where learning feels like play and every child is seen.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.desc: To give children aged 2 to 6 a strong foundation through play-based learning, personal attention and the security of a caring school.

v1.title: Care first
v1.desc: Every decision starts with the safety and happiness of the child.

v2.title: Learning through play
v2.desc: Children learn best when they are engaged, curious and having fun.

v3.title: Trust with parents
v3.desc: We share daily updates because parenting is a partnership.

v4.title: Respect for every child
v4.desc: Each child is an individual, noticed and valued as they are.

v5.title: A calm, gentle approach
v5.desc: Children grow best in a calm environment with warm, consistent guidance.

v6.title: Continuous learning
v6.desc: Teachers keep learning too, so the school always gets better.

foundation.title: Part of the Foundation's wider work
foundation.desc: The school is one part of Shri Swami Samarth Krupa Foundation's services in Satpur, Nashik. Your child's fees help support the Foundation's ongoing community work.

framework.title: The First Step Growth Framework
framework.sub: Six areas of development guide everything we plan in the classroom — and everything we suggest at home.
framework.intro: A child is not a subject to be taught, but a whole person to be grown. Our framework keeps that growth balanced: language and numbers alongside movement, feelings and friendships.

f1.title: Language
f1.desc: We fill every day with stories, rhymes, songs and real conversation. Children hear rich language, then begin using it themselves.
f1.school: Story time, rhymes, picture books and circle-time conversations.
f1.home: Talk about the day, read a picture book, sing songs together.

f2.title: Numeracy
f2.desc: Children meet numbers the natural way — counting children, sorting blocks, noticing patterns. Thinking is taught through puzzles and questions.
f2.school: Counting games, sorting activities, patterns and simple puzzles.
f2.home: Count stairs and plates; sort socks; spot patterns in clothes and leaves.

f3.title: Movement
f3.desc: Bodies and brains grow together. Running, climbing, balancing and fine-motor activities build coordination, health and confidence.
f3.school: Outdoor play, obstacle games, balancing and fine-motor activities.
f3.home: Time to run and climb; drawing, scribbling and play with dough.

f4.title: Social Skills
f4.desc: Children learn to be with others — to share, wait, help and play together. These skills matter as much as letters.
f4.school: Group activities, taking turns, helping each other and playing together.
f4.home: Family meals, playing with cousins, small chores together.

f5.title: Confidence
f5.desc: A confident child tries new things, asks questions and speaks up. We build confidence through encouragement and small responsibilities.
f5.school: Sharing in circle time, choosing activities, receiving encouragement.
f5.home: Let children try things themselves; celebrate effort, not just results.

f6.title: Creativity
f6.desc: Creativity is thinking, making and expressing — in art, music, drama and open-ended play. It is how children explore and grow.
f6.school: Art and craft, music, pretend play and building with blocks.
f6.home: Crayons, paper, dress-up clothes and open-ended play materials.

safety.title: A place you can leave your child without worrying
safety.sub: Every corner of First Step is designed with your child's safety in mind — from the entrance to the last corner of the playground.

s1.title: Large, separate classrooms
s1.desc: Each class has its own big, ventilated classroom, so children are never crowded together.

s2.title: Private, secure campus
s2.desc: The whole 5500 sq ft campus is private and enclosed — classrooms of 2500 sq ft and a playground of 3000 sq ft.

s3.title: Full CCTV coverage
s3.desc: CCTV cameras keep watch over classrooms and common areas, and recordings are reviewed regularly.

s4.title: Safe, supervised play
s4.desc: The playground is private and always supervised, so children play freely within a protected space.

s5.title: Careful handover
s5.desc: Children are handed over only to parents or people the parents have authorised, in person.

s6.title: Clean, hygienic spaces
s6.desc: Classrooms and washrooms are cleaned daily, and hygiene routines are part of the school day.

s7.title: Emergency-ready staff
s7.desc: Staff know what to do in an emergency, and the school keeps essential contact details updated.

s8.title: Safe van service
s8.desc: The van service follows a fixed, known route, and every journey is supervised.
